Flipkart to launch food delivery service, challenging Zomato and Swiggy

Flipkart is testing a new food delivery service named 'Eat-in by Minutes' with approximately 8,000 employees in Bengaluru. The company is reportedly preparing for a public launch, which is anticipated by the end of October 2026. This new service aims to compete with existing food delivery platforms like Zomato and Swiggy, allowing users to order food through a single app.
